core: Expand fiber coverage in greenfield areas to acquire new FBB and FMC subscribers.
meaning_cn: 在绿区扩大光纤覆盖，以获取新的固定宽带和融合业务用户。
explanation_cn: greenfield 通常写作一个词，作形容词修饰 areas，表示尚未建设或缺少现有网络覆盖的新增建设区域。expand fiber coverage in... 表示在某类区域扩大光纤覆盖；acquire new subscribers 是电信商业汇报中常见的用户获取表达。PPT 标题可写为：Expand Fiber Coverage in Greenfield Areas to Acquire New FBB and FMC Subscribers。
source_sentence: Green Field: Expanding Fiber Coverage to Acquire New FBB and FMC Subscribers

examples.en: Expand fiber coverage in greenfield areas to acquire new FBB and FMC subscribers.
examples.cn: 在绿区扩大光纤覆盖，以获取新的固定宽带和融合业务用户。

examples.en: Greenfield expansion can open new sources of subscriber growth.
examples.cn: 绿区扩张可以开辟新的用户增长来源。

examples.en: Prioritize greenfield areas with strong demand and limited existing coverage.
examples.cn: 优先考虑需求强劲且现有覆盖有限的绿区。

pronunciation.text: Expand fiber coverage in greenfield areas to acquire new FBB and FMC subscribers.
pronunciation.hint_cn: 重读 expand、fiber coverage、greenfield areas、acquire、FBB、FMC 和 subscribers；FBB 与 FMC 逐字母读。

core: Distributed OLT deployment can reuse mobile sites and uplink fiber, reducing the cost per home passed.
meaning_cn: 分布式 OLT 部署可以复用移动站点和上行光纤，从而降低每户覆盖成本。
explanation_cn: distributed OLT deployment 表示分布式 OLT 部署。reuse mobile sites and uplink fiber 表示复用移动站点及上行光纤；在移动通信语境中 mobile sites 通常比 wireless sites 更自然。cost per home passed 是固定宽带建设中“每户覆盖成本”的标准表达。reducing... 用现在分词说明前述复用带来的结果。
source_sentence: OLT分布式部署，复用无线站点与上行光纤，可降低HP成本

examples.en: Distributed OLT deployment can reuse mobile sites and uplink fiber, reducing the cost per home passed.
examples.cn: 分布式 OLT 部署可以复用移动站点和上行光纤，从而降低每户覆盖成本。

examples.en: Reusing existing site infrastructure can reduce fiber deployment costs.
examples.cn: 复用现有站点基础设施可以降低光纤部署成本。

examples.en: The distributed architecture lowers the cost per home passed in low-density areas.
examples.cn: 分布式架构可以降低低密度区域的每户覆盖成本。

pronunciation.text: Distributed OLT deployment can reuse mobile sites and uplink fiber, reducing the cost per home passed.
pronunciation.hint_cn: 重读 distributed OLT deployment、reuse、mobile sites、uplink fiber、reducing 和 cost per home passed；OLT 逐字母读。

core: FMC contribution strengthens the ROI of greenfield FBB investment.
meaning_cn: FMC 贡献能够提升绿区 FBB 投资的回报率。
explanation_cn: FMC contribution 表示融合业务带来的增量贡献；strengthens the ROI of... 比 with FMC contribution 更明确地表达 FMC 对投资回报的正向作用。greenfield FBB investment 表示绿区固定宽带投资。PPT 标题可写为：FMC Contribution Strengthens Greenfield FBB ROI。
source_sentence: Tigo El Salvador Greenfield FBB ROI with FMC Contribution

examples.en: FMC contribution strengthens the ROI of greenfield FBB investment.
examples.cn: FMC 贡献能够提升绿区 FBB 投资的回报率。

examples.en: The ROI model includes both FBB revenue and incremental FMC contribution.
examples.cn: 该 ROI 模型同时纳入 FBB 收入和 FMC 增量贡献。

examples.en: Adding FMC benefits improves the investment case for greenfield expansion.
examples.cn: 纳入 FMC 收益后，绿区扩张的投资逻辑更有吸引力。

pronunciation.text: FMC contribution strengthens the ROI of greenfield FBB investment.
pronunciation.hint_cn: 重读 FMC contribution、strengthens、ROI、greenfield FBB investment；FMC、ROI 和 FBB 逐字母读。

core: Prioritize the first 10K homes passed in high-value overlap areas to reduce future competitive risk.
meaning_cn: 优先建设高价值重叠区域的首批 1 万户覆盖，以降低未来竞争风险。
explanation_cn: prioritize the first 10K homes passed 表示优先推进首批 1 万户覆盖；homes passed 是固定宽带建设中的标准覆盖口径。high-value overlap areas 指同时满足高价值和网络重叠条件的区域。to reduce future competitive risk 清楚说明优先建设的战略目的。
source_sentence: 考虑先建设10K重叠高价值区域，减少未来竞争风险

examples.en: Prioritize the first 10K homes passed in high-value overlap areas to reduce future competitive risk.
examples.cn: 优先建设高价值重叠区域的首批 1 万户覆盖，以降低未来竞争风险。

examples.en: The first phase should focus on high-value areas with the greatest competitive exposure.
examples.cn: 第一阶段应聚焦竞争风险最高的高价值区域。

examples.en: A targeted initial build can protect priority areas before competition intensifies.
examples.cn: 有针对性的首期建设可以在竞争加剧前保护重点区域。

pronunciation.text: Prioritize the first 10K homes passed in high-value overlap areas to reduce future competitive risk.
pronunciation.hint_cn: 重读 prioritize、first 10K homes passed、high-value overlap areas、reduce 和 competitive risk；10K 读作 ten K。
